article.story: CLEVELAND -- — Rayvon Griffith’s 20 points helped Cleveland State defeat Case Western Reserve 76-46 on Wednesday. Griffith finished 10 of 17 from the field for the Vikings (4-4). Jordan Lowery scored 10 points, shooting 4 for 8, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc. Alex Vincent finished with 11 points, six rebounds and four blocks for the Spartans. Case Western Reserve also got 10 points from Will Taylor. Caleb Laurich finished with nine points and 11 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
